summary.text: Monica Blasdel (Monica Robb Blasdel) is a Republican state representative from Columbiana who has represented Ohio House District 79 since January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists her career experience in sales and as a regional liaison in the office of Lt. Gov. Jon Husted.

paragraphs.text: Blasdel was born in Columbiana County, graduated from Crestview High School, and earned a B.S. in business administration from the University of Akron in 2005.
She worked as a sales representative at Cedar Fair Entertainment, a media consultant at Time Warner Cable and northeast regional liaison in the office of Lt. Gov. Jon Husted.
Blasdel defeated Democrat Dan Votaw in the November 5, 2024 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her committees as Arts, Athletics, and Tourism; Natural Resources, which she chairs; and Transportation.
Bob Guy is the Democratic candidate in the 2026 general election.
